properties.description: On premise SQL Server for generated queries.
On premise SQL Server, named table.

query.value:
select 
  t.TABLE_CAT
, t.TABLE_SCHEM
, s.SCHEMA_TEXT
, t.TABLE_NAME
, t.TABLE_TYPE
, t.REMARKS
, t.TYPE_CAT
, t.TYPE_SCHEM
, t.TYPE_NAME as table_type_name
, t.SELF_REFERENCING_COL_NAME
, t.REF_GENERATION
, t.DBNAME
, t.TABLE_TEXT
, c.COLUMN_NAME
, c.DATA_TYPE
, c.TYPE_NAME as column_type_name
, c.COLUMN_SIZE
, c.BUFFER_LENGTH
, c.DECIMAL_DIGITS
, c.NUM_PREC_RADIX
, c.NULLABLE
, c.REMARKS as column_remarks
, c.COLUMN_DEF
, c.SQL_DATA_TYPE
, c.SQL_DATETIME_SUB
, c.CHAR_OCTET_LENGTH
, c.ORDINAL_POSITION
, c.IS_NULLABLE
, c.JDBC_DATA_TYPE
, c.SCOPE_CATALOG
, c.SCOPE_SCHEMA
, c.SCOPE_TABLE
, c.SOURCE_DATA_TYPE
, c.PSEUDO_COLUMN
, c.COLUMN_TEXT
, c.SYSTEM_COLUMN_NAME
, c.I_DATA_TYPE
, c.HIDDEN
, c.HAS_DEFAULT
, c.SOURCE_TYPE_NAME
, c.SOURCE_SQL_DATA_TYPE
, c.SOURCE_JDBC_DATA_TYPE
, pk.KEY_SEQ
, pk.PK_NAME
, '@{utcNow()}' as measure_time
FROM sysibm.SQLTABLES t
join sysibm.SQLSCHEMAS s on s.TABLE_CAT = t.TABLE_CAT and s.TABLE_SCHEM = t.TABLE_SCHEM
join sysibm.SQLcolumns c on c.TABLE_CAT = t.TABLE_CAT and c.TABLE_SCHEM = t.TABLE_SCHEM and c.TABLE_NAME = t.TABLE_NAME
left join sysibm.SQLPrimaryKeys pk on pk.TABLE_CAT = pk.TABLE_CAT and pk.TABLE_SCHEM = t.TABLE_SCHEM and pk.TABLE_NAME = t.TABLE_NAME and pk.COLUMN_NAME = c.COLUMN_NAME
where s.TABLE_SCHEM IN ('MM760LIB', 'MMLIBARCH', 'QGPL', 'STKUPD')
/*
(t.table_name in ('POMHDR' ,
'POMCAN',
'POMHST',
'POSTAT',
'POMDTL',
'POMDSQ',
'POMXTK',
'EDAASNI')
or t.table_name like 'INV%' and t.table_name not like '%DUPE%')
*/

/* 
-- Collect these:
+ MM760LIB	MMS 7.6.0 Database Library
+ MMLIBARCH	MM760LIB Archive Library
+ QGPL	    General Purpose Library
+ STKUPD	  Library for Stock Ledger Level Clearing

-- Ignore these:
- POMRST910	null
- MM760DVL	MMS 7.6.0 Development Database Files
- MM760QAL	MMS 7.6.0 QA Database Files
 */
select '@{item().table_schem}' table_schema, '@{item().table_name}' table_name, count(*) num_rows, '@{utcNow()}' measure_time from @{item().table_schem}.@{item().table_name}

select 'S10F8F6P' AS TABLE_CAT, 'AHLIB' AS TABLE_SCHEM, 'POMHDR' AS TABLE_NAME, 'PURCHASE ORDER HEADER FILE' AS TABLE_TEXT, 'POEDAT' AS COLUMN_NAME, 'Entry Date' AS COLUMN_TEXT
, MIN(POEDAT) as MIN_DATE, MAX(POEDAT) AS MAX_DATE, '@{utcNow()}' AS MEASURE_TIME
from AHLIB.POMHDR 
union select 'S10F8F6P', 'AHLIB', 'POMHDR', 'PURCHASE ORDER HEADER FILE',     'POLCHG', 'Last Change Date'
, MIN(POLCHG) as MIN_DATE, MAX(POLCHG), '@{utcNow()}'
from AHLIB.POMHDR 
union select 'S10F8F6P', 'MM760DVL', 'POMHDR', 'PURCHASE ORDER HEADER FILE',  'POEDAT', 'Entry Date' 
, MIN(POEDAT) as MIN_DATE, MAX(POEDAT), '@{utcNow()}'
from MM760DVL.POMHDR 
union select 'S10F8F6P', 'MM760DVL', 'POMHDR', 'PURCHASE ORDER HEADER FILE',  'POLCHG', 'Last Change Date'
, MIN(POLCHG) as MIN_DATE, MAX(POLCHG), '@{utcNow()}'

query.value:
select   table_catalog as TableCatalog, table_schema as TableSchema, table_name as TableName, partition_id as PartitionId, total_rows as TotalRows, last_modified_time as LastModifiedTime
FROM  @{activity('Get Pipeline Parameters').output.firstRow.SourcedsTableCatalog}.@{activity('Get Pipeline Parameters').output.firstRow.SourcedsTableSchema}.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARTITIONS @{if(greater(pipeline().parameters.DataAgeLimitHours, 0), concat('where last_modified_time > timestamp(parse_datetime(''%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%E*SZ'', ''', addHours(pipeline().TriggerTime, mul(-1, pipeline().parameters.DataAgeLimitHours)), '''))'), '')}

sqlReaderQuery.value:
select  count(*) numBatches
    ,   string_agg(convert(nvarchar(max), CountCmd), ' union all ') CountCmd
    ,   string_agg(convert(nvarchar(max), TableName), ',') TableList 
from    dbo.gbqObjectToLoadCmd 
where TableCatalog = '@{activity('Get Pipeline Parameters').output.firstRow.SourcedsTableCatalog}' and TableSchema = '@{activity('Get Pipeline Parameters').output.firstRow.SourcedsTableSchema}'

text.value:
update  dbo.adfPipelineExecution 
set     EndTimeUtc = '@{formatDateTime(utcNow(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff')}',
        BatchCount = @{activity('Get_RowCountQueries').output.value[0].numBatches},
        StatusMessage = 'Succeeded'
where   Id = @{activity('LogJobStart').output.value[0].Id}

activities.name: LogJobStart
activities.description: Record the Pipeline start in LoadControl and capture the Id of the row for use in auditing.

sqlReaderQuery.value:
insert into dbo.adfPipelineExecution (PipelineName, RunId, StartTimeUtc, StatusMessage, Parameters)
output inserted.Id
select '@{pipeline().Pipeline}', '@{pipeline().RunId}', '@{formatDateTime(utcNow(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff')}', 'In Progress', Parameters = (select '@{pipeline().parameters.BatchRowLimit}' as BatchRowLimit, '@{activity('Get Pipeline Parameters').output.firstRow.SourcedsTableCatalog}' as TableCatalog, '@{activity('Get Pipeline Parameters').output.firstRow.SourcedsTableSchema}' as TableSchema for json path)

text.value:
update  dbo.adfPipelineExecution 
set     EndTimeUtc = '@{formatDateTime(utcNow(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff')}',
        BatchCount = -1,
        StatusMessage = 'Failed'
where   Id = @{activity('LogJobStart').output.value[0].Id}

activities.name: Get_ColumnQuery
activities.description: Builds a query to run against Google to find the column definition for each Google object not yet loaded.

sqlReaderQuery.value:
/* This runs on SQL Server (LoadControl)*/
with cte as (
    select
        /* Build WHERE condition for query on GBQ  */
        gbqCondition = convert(nvarchar(max), concat('table_name = ''', TableName, '''')),
        /* Build WHERE condition for query on SQL  */
        sqlCondition = convert(nvarchar(max), concat('TableCatalog = ''', TableCatalog, ''' and TableSchema = ''', TableSchema, ''' and TableName = ''', TableName, '''')) 
    from dbo.gbqObjectToLoad
    where TableCatalog = '@{activity('Get Pipeline Parameters').output.firstRow.SourcedsTableCatalog}' and TableSchema = '@{activity('Get Pipeline Parameters').output.firstRow.SourcedsTableSchema}'
    group by    TableCatalog, TableSchema, TableName
)
select      gbqSelectCmd = 'select table_catalog as TableCatalog, table_schema as TableSchema, table_name as TableName, column_name as ColumnName, coalesce(ordinal_position, -1) as ColumnId, data_type as DataType, cast(case when is_partitioning_column = ''YES'' then 1 else 0 end as boolean) as IsPartitioningColumn from @{activity('Get Pipeline Parameters').output.firstRow.SourcedsTableCatalog}.@{activity('Get Pipeline Parameters').output.firstRow.SourcedsTableSchema}.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c where ' + string_agg(gbqCondition, ' or '),
            sqlDeleteCmd = 'delete from dbo.gbqColumn where ' + string_agg(sqlCondition, ' or ')
from        cte
